decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - A method statement for all repair and restoration works shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - Samples of the proposed materials including the roofing and timber boarding shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.
Condition : 5 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the approved drawings.
description: Erection of a pitched roof to existing rear extension of dwellinghouse (Listed Building)
